# Code of conduct

Be kind and be useful. Broccoli is built by a small team, and every issue and
comment here is read by a person.

## Not welcome

- Insults, harassment, or personal and political attacks
- Sexualised language or imagery
- Publishing anyone's private information without their permission
- Trolling, spam, or anything you wouldn't say at work

## What we do about it

Maintainers may edit or delete comments, close or lock issues, and block
people who break these rules. We explain our decisions when it helps.

To report a problem privately, email hello@getbroccoli.com.

This code applies in this repository and wherever someone speaks for Broccoli
in public. It is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
